findings.problem: "Taken hot after a meal" for the Spanish carajillo has no source: the Library’s Carajillo card and lore say only that Spain spikes espresso with brandy. The after-lunch and after-dinner lines are about Mexico.
findings.change: Now "In Spain it is hot coffee spiked with brandy"; the explanation drops "after a meal".

findings.problem: "From Cartagena" alone reads as Cartagena, Colombia, in an entry about a Mexican drink.
findings.change: Now "from Cartagena in Spain", as the pack’s Licor 43 card has it.
